rule.signal: KRX 15007 KOSPI200 call options, foreign net_krw / market_total buy_krw, on KR session d
rule.reference: median of the same ratio over the 60 observed sessions before d (d excluded); at least 40 required
rule.position: +1 if signal > reference, -1 if signal < reference, 0 if equal; applied to the next KRX session t after d
rule.outcome_primary: KOSPI index open-to-close return on t (Naver daily chart)
rule.outcome_secondary: 005930 open-to-close return on t (report only, not a decision input)
rule.decision: No decision before 250 scored primary targets. At 250: the edge is supported if the mean primary pnl is at least the 2bp cost reference AND Newey-West(5) t >= 2.0 on gross pnl. Otherwise it is not supported. Interim numbers are progress only.

retrospective_reference.note: selected from about 65 tests; not evidence on its own
